The Sight of Salvation: King Dasharatha's Hand at Sita Kund, Gaya
You won't believe your eyes! We are LIVE at Sita Kund, Gaya Ji Dhaam, the most sacred and mysterious spot on the banks of the Falgu River. This is where the unthinkable happened: Mata Sita performed Pind Daan, and King Dasharatha's hand miraculously emerged from the sand to accept her offering!
